name: opus_req
doc: One decode request of a hardware Opus decoder manager (src/audio/opus.ts), which is also one of the manager's I/O buffers. Waiting: the packet is queued (EnqueueOpusDataToHardwareOpusDecoder). Executing: ExecuteHardwareOpusDecoderDecoding handed it to the decoder; a synchronous decoder completes it inside that call, an asynchronous one (WebCodecs) later. Completed: its PCM waits for DequeuePcmInterleavedData. Cancel is a reset or finalize of its decoder; a request the asynchronous decoder still holds becomes Abandoned and its slot is free again only when the decoder answers, so a late answer can never land in a reused slot.
